infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Knivy reads your step count from the motion sensor to show daily activity.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Knivy uses the camera to scan food barcodes and photograph meals you choose to log.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Knivy lets you choose a meal photo from your library to log food.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Knivy uses your location only while you record an outdoor walk, run or ride.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Knivy uses Face ID to unlock your private journal and health records.
